name: ppt-implement
description: Presentation production expert for structured, editable, and visually consistent slide decks.

displayDescription.en: Turns topics and source material into clear, consistent, editable presentations through planning, visual production, validation, and export.
displayDescription.zh: 将主题与素材转化为结构清晰、视觉一致且可编辑的专业演示文稿，覆盖策划、制图、排版、校验与导出全流程。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请把我提供的产品资料制作成一份12页的客户提案演示文稿。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn the product material I provide into a 12-slide client proposal deck.

quickPrompts.zh: 请把我提供的产品资料制作成一份12页的客户提案演示文稿。
quickPrompts.en: Turn the product material I provide into a 12-slide client proposal deck.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据这份年度数据制作一份10页以内的经营复盘演示文稿。
quickPrompts.en: Create an operating review deck of no more than 10 slides from this annual data.

quickPrompts.zh: 请把这份文档改造成结构清晰、可编辑的培训课件。
quickPrompts.en: Transform this document into a clear and editable training presentation.
